name: io.github.ZcrafterAI/bridge
title: Zcrafter Bridge
description: IBM z/OS mainframe tools for AI agents. Every change needs a person's approval.

environmentVariables.name: MAINFRAME_WORKFLOW_ZOWE_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Zowe z/OSMF profile to use. Defaults to the profile named default.

environmentVariables.name: ZOWE_OPT_HOST
environmentVariables.description: z/OSMF host, when not using a Zowe profile.

environmentVariables.name: ZOWE_OPT_USER
environmentVariables.description: Mainframe user ID, when not using a Zowe profile.

environmentVariables.name: ZOWE_OPT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Mainframe password, when not using a Zowe profile.

environmentVariables.name: MAINFRAME_WORKFLOW_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to offer no tool that changes anything.

environmentVariables.name: MAINFRAME_WORKFLOW_PROTECTED_DATASETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated dataset patterns nothing may write to, e.g. SYS1.**,*.PROD.**
